The upstream source is vendored unchanged, including miniz's own notices.
Lumi Books builds it as a separate libmobi.so, without encryption or external
libxml2/zlib dependencies. The allocation hooks/build configuration are in
app/src/main/cpp. Corresponding source and reproducible instructions are in
this application's public source repository:
https://github.com/huangder/Lumi_Books/tree/main/third_party/libmobi
https://github.com/huangder/Lumi_Books/blob/main/devdocs/kindle-native.md
The library may be modified and replaced; no restriction is imposed on reverse
engineering for debugging modifications to this LGPL-covered component.
